extraction.schema_coverage: Only commands present in generated_schemas.json have a parameter schema. Missing schema is not interpreted as zero parameters.
extraction.command_status_semantics: Registry status is metadata; it is not independently verified implementation evidence.

accepted_command_identifiers: numeric cmd_id converted to decimal string
execution_model.parameter_transport: One serde_json::Value object passed to the handler; command-specific keys are read by the handler.
execution_model.resolution: Session::resolve_command_name resolves numeric cmd_id and ID_* source_symbol to the canonical dotted id; otherwise uses input unchanged.
execution_model.transaction_behavior: Commands outside the explicit meta/history allowlist open an automatic history transaction when none is active. The engine snapshots document, tool database, toolpaths and current file path, executes under catch_unwind, commits on success, rolls back on returned error, and restores snapshots on panic.
notes: This inventory describes the old Bus as implemented, not the target Gravita API.
The old Bus accepts JSON values and command aliases; the new contract is free to rename and normalize commands and payloads.
